name: 57005 · Brandon, SD
findings: ZIP 57005 (Brandon) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57005 (Brandon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 57005 (Brandon) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
